text:
zoe: Brain dump for the "Pulse Launch" experiment. Idea: use a tiny "starter tokens" gift plus a compact prompt template library and a short 20-min webinar to improve first-week retention. Main ask: routing snippet + messaging variants.

carlos: Webinar time Fri 9am PT works. I'll do 2 reminder emails: immediate and 1hr before. Also plan an in-product banner.

maya: Suggest split 50/50 for initial test: credits-only vs credits+promptpack+webinar. Need to ensure cohorts are balanced by region/time-of-day.

vik: Ops note: webinar hosting infra should expect spikes. Recommend fallback recording + embed for > concurrent 200.

cleo: Routing pseudo-config:
```
segment: new_user_cohort_0-5d
trigger: second_successful_call
actions:
  - issue_tokens: 80
  - enroll_promptpack: pulse-starters-v1
  - send_webinar_invite: +48h
metrics: calls_first_48h, prompt_use_pct, day7_retention
```
Also add experiment_id as metadata.

growth-bot: Baseline metrics: day7 retention 18.9%, avg tokens week1 2.6k, est unit cost $6.00. CSV uploaded.

zoe: Messaging drafts: short headline "Build with templates in 20 minutes" and a more aspirational variant "Ship AI features that delight". We'll A/B test.

carlos: I'll land the copy and push to the landing page. Maya can you confirm cohorts sizing?

maya: Yes aiming for ~800 per arm. I'll coordinate with growth ops.

zoe: Action items:
- carlos: landing + emails (EOD)
- cleo: routing rule + experiment tagging (tomorrow)
- maya: cohort sizing + seed distribution (tomorrow AM)
- growth-bot: attach baseline CSV and refresh once run starts

zoe: We'll reconvene post-launch for a 1-week look. :eyes:
